title: A specified finite free presentation yields a Hom kernel on the same open
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], G and F arbitrary O_X-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], V an open of X and m,n >= 0. Suppose a: O_V^{oplus m} -> O_V^{oplus n} is a module morphism on the slice site over V, with a specified isomorphism e: Coker(a) ~= G|_V [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation]. Then there is a morphism alpha: (F|_V)^{oplus n} -> (F|_V)^{oplus m} of O_V-modules whose kernel is isomorphic to Hom_O_X(G,F)|_V [def-pur-sheaf-hom]. The conclusion uses scheme restriction along V -> X on precisely that same open V and the same ranks; neither G nor F is required to be coherent.

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01CO (1), Lemma 01CQ, and proof of Lemma 01CP; Sites, Modules, Lemma 0E8H.

proof.text: Set b to the cokernel projection followed by e.hom. The sequence a,b,0 is right exact. Identify the finite biproducts of the restricted unit with finite free modules and apply homObj_precomposition_exact on the slice site over V with target F.over V.

Use the proved upstream homObjFreeIso to identify the free-source Hom terms with finite biproducts of F.over V, reindexing ULift (Fin n) and ULift (Fin m). Transport the maps. The first map is monic and identifies its source with the kernel of the transported second map alpha.

Use the proved upstream overHomObjIso to identify the source with (homObj G F).over V. Apply Mathlib Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V and overFunctorEquiv V; this equivalence preserves kernels and finite biproducts and identifies slice restriction with scheme restriction. Thus the transported alpha and kernel isomorphism have the stated types. Empty biproducts obey the same universal properties.

theorem homObj_locally_kernel_of_local_presentation
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (G F : X.Modules) (V : X.Opens) (m n : ℕ)
    (a : (⨁ fun _ : Fin m ↦ (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).over V) ⟶
      (⨁ fun _ : Fin n ↦ (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).over V))
    (e : (cokernel a) ≅ G.over V) :
    ∃ (α : (⨁ fun _ : Fin n ↦ F.restrict V.ι) ⟶
      (⨁ fun _ : Fin m ↦ F.restrict V.ι)),
      Nonempty ((restrictFunctor V.ι).obj
        (SheafOfModules.homObj (R := X.sheaf) G F) ≅ kernel α)
